decision: Do not start the 31-us production campaign under the current adaptive policy.

native_runtime_provenance.verification: native base, complete patch, source hashes, and runtime artifacts verified

sustained_post_event_dt_recovery.reason: Only five post-event accepts exceeded 0.5 ns; maximum was 0.6 ns and the final step returned to the floor.

operational_runtime.warning: This is a worst-case extrapolation, not a production forecast; it is sufficient to reject the current campaign gate.

root_cause_classification.bdf2_reentry_behavior: BDF2 trial is retried after estimator error exceeds one; retry returns to BDF1 and the floor cooldown. This is reproducible and policy-consistent.
root_cause_classification.remaining_issue: The unchanged estimator/controller combination does not sustain recovery above dt_min after BDF2 re-entry.

required_before_31us: Keep the current Stage 11A event-boundary contract as a regression gate.
Design and validate a separately approved estimator/BDF2 recovery change on the 20-ns case.
Repeat the 20-ns baseline with the candidate change and demonstrate sustained dt recovery plus bounded BDF2 rejects.
Only then reconsider the 31-us production run.
